query:
SELECT a.user_id AS "user_id!"
           FROM card_assignees a
           WHERE a.card_id = $1
             AND a.user_id != $2
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM notifications n
               WHERE n.user_id = a.user_id
                 AND n.type = $3
                 AND json_extract(n.payload, '$.card_id') = $1
                 AND n.created_at >= $4
             )
           ORDER BY a.user_id
